Content:
Finally, let's see how we can evaluate linear expressions in context.

Content:
Suppose the temperature (in degrees Celsius) after [MATH: t] hours of a liquid mixture as it cools is given by the expression
[MATH: 38 - 4t.]
What is the temperature of the mixture after [MATH: \dfrac52] hours?

Content:
To determine the temperature after [MATH: \dfrac{5}{2}] hours, we replace [MATH: t] with [MATH: \dfrac52] and evaluate the resulting expression:

Content:
[MATH: 38 − 4t|=; 38 − 4 × t|=; 38 − (4)/(1) × (5)/(2)|=; 38 − (4)/(2) × (5)/(1)|=; 38 − 2 × 5|=; 38 − 10|=; 28]

Content:
Therefore, the temperature after [MATH: \dfrac52] hours is [MATH: 28\,^\circ\textrm{C}.]
